This template is designed for the specific use of content that is released exclusively through the [[StarWarsKids.com|''Star Wars'' Kids]] YouTube channel. Videos that are otherwise embedded within a larger webpage should use [[Template:SWKids]].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below for the required usage and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{SWKidsYouTube|video=|text=|date=|quote=|parameter=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|video}} Use the alphanumeric part of the url that comes after "<code>watch?v=</code>" in the url. Please do not include anything other than this.
*{{Para|text}} Title of the video.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|date}} Date the Youtube video was published online. In the format <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>.
*{{Para|quote}} To include a quote. 
*{{Para|parameter}} To create a link to a channel's playlist, use <code>|parameter=playlist?list</code>.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp|YouTube}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{SWKidsYouTube|bb3vhWXClTY|Every Ship in the Star Wars Sequel Trilogy &amp;#124; Star Wars By the Numbers}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:
{{SWKidsYouTube|bb3vhWXClTY|Every Ship in the Star Wars Sequel Trilogy &#124; Star Wars By the Numbers}}

{{BucketsList|JyX9pS6q6m4|#1.4: "Fuel for the Fire" &#124; Star Wars Resistance|sw_url=video/buckets-list-fuel-for-the-fire-star-wars-resistance|nolive=1}}
